grammar_tips.title: Expressing Causes and Effects
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'because', 'due to', 'as a result', and 'therefore' to connect ideas. Example: 'Outsourcing is popular because it reduces costs.'

grammar_tips.title: Making Comparisons
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'more/less...than', 'the most/least', and comparative forms: 'Trade is easier now than before.'

grammar_tips.title: Using Passive Voice
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the passive to focus on the action: 'Jobs are outsourced to other countries.'

example_sentences.sentence: Globalization has led to greater cultural exchange.
Many multinational companies have offices around the world.
Outsourcing is used by businesses to lower costs.
Some people believe that globalization increases inequality.
Standardization makes products similar in many countries.

speaking.question: Explain what globalization means in your own words.
speaking.answer: Globalization is when countries and people around the world become more connected through trade and culture.

speaking.question: Give one positive effect of globalization.
speaking.answer: A positive effect is that people can experience new cultures and ideas.

speaking.question: Describe a negative impact of globalization.
speaking.answer: One negative impact is that it can increase inequality between countries.

speaking.question: Discuss how multinational companies influence local cultures.
speaking.answer: Multinational companies can influence local cultures by bringing new products and changing local traditions.

speaking.question: Suggest one way to balance the benefits and drawbacks of globalization.
speaking.answer: Countries can create fair trade rules to help both workers and businesses benefit.
